versions.changelog:
- Initial release of NotFair Google Ads agent for OpenClaw.
- Diagnose live Google Ads accounts and audit wasted spend.
- Review search terms, draft negative keywords, and inspect policy errors.
- Propose approval-gated campaign changes securely via the NotFair MCP server.
- Implements strict safety model: all account changes require explicit user approval.
- Provides setup instructions and default workflow for optimal use.
